text:
Type: round black coffee table
Use: holding drinks, books and decor; living room, family room
Style: Scandinavian, modern, mid-century modern
Materials: black painted solid wood legs, painted wood-based top
Colors: matte black
Shape: large round top with a molded edge, four angled splayed legs joined by a crossed stretcher, open base, medium visual weight
Feel: graphic, calm, bold, grounded
Goes with: light wood floors, white or grey sofas, brass or white accents; Scandinavian or modern living rooms

product.name: KRAGSTA
product.description: The round shape gives you a generous table top for trays, coffee or tea services. And the neat dimensions make the table easy to place in the room.
